description_target.target_text: copy the colored 3x3-neighborhood template around every matching macro-cell

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Separator lines split the board into a MACRO lattice (each block's
 ;; value = its modal color). One block has the richest set of colored
 ;; neighbors — that neighborhood is the LESSON: copy it (as relative
 ;; offsets) around every other block of the same color, filling only
 ;; empty blocks. Paint the result back through the lattice.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (full-row? r)
       (and (not (= (at g r 0) 0))
            (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) (at g r 0))) (range 0 w))))
     (define (full-col? c)
       (and (not (= (at g 0 c) 0))
            (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) (at g 0 c))) (range 0 h))))
     (define all-full-rows (filter full-row? (range 0 h)))
     (define all-full-cols (filter full-col? (range 0 w)))
     (define sep
       (if (empty? all-full-rows)
           (at g 0 (first all-full-cols))
           (at g (first all-full-rows) 0)))
     (define sep-rows
       (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r 0) sep)) all-full-rows))
     (define sep-cols
       (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g 0 c) sep)) all-full-cols))
     (define (intervals n seps)  ;; block spans between separators
       (let loop ((rem seps) (start 0) (acc (list)))
         (cond ((empty? rem)
                (reverse (if (<= start (- n 1))
                             (cons (list start (- n 1)) acc)
                             acc)))
               ((<= start (- (first rem) 1))
                (loop (rest rem) (+ (first rem) 1)
                      (cons (list start (- (first rem) 1)) acc)))
               (else (loop (rest rem) (+ (first rem) 1) acc)))))
     (define ris (intervals h sep-rows))
     (define cis (intervals w sep-cols))
     (define R (length ris))
     (define C (length cis))
     (define (index-in ints x)
       (let loop ((idx 0) (xs ints))
         (cond ((empty? xs) #f)
               ((and (>= x (first (first xs)))
                     (<= x (second (first xs))))
                idx)
               (else (loop (+ idx 1) (rest xs))))))
     (define macro
       (build-grid R C (i j)
                   (let ((vals (for*/list ((r (range (first (nth ris i))
                                                     (+ (second (nth ris i))
                                                        1)))
                                           (c (range (first (nth cis j))
                                                     (+ (second (nth cis j))
                                                        1)))
                                           #:when (and (not (= (at g r c)
                                                               0))
                                                       (not (= (at g r c)
                                                               sep))))
                                 (at g r c))))
                     (if (empty? vals) 0 (mode-list vals)))))
     (define (neighborhood i j target)  ;; (dr dc color) of other colors
       (for*/list ((dr (list -1 0 1)) (dc (list -1 0 1))
                   #:when (and (not (and (zero? dr) (zero? dc)))
                               (in-bounds? (+ i dr) (+ j dc) R C)
                               (not (= (at macro (+ i dr) (+ j dc)) 0))
                               (not (= (at macro (+ i dr) (+ j dc))
                                       target))))
         (list dr dc (at macro (+ i dr) (+ j dc)))))
     (define best  ;; the block with the richest neighborhood
       (pick-max (filter (lambda (e) (> (first e) 0))
                         (for*/list ((i (range 0 R)) (j (range 0 C)))
                           (let* ((target (at macro i j))
                                  (pat (if (zero? target)
                                           (list)
                                           (neighborhood i j target))))
                             (list (length pat) i j target pat))))
                 first))
     (define filled  ;; replicate the lesson around every target block
       (for*/fold ((m macro)) ((i (range 0 R)) (j (range 0 C)))
         (if (= (at m i j) (fourth best))
             (for/fold ((mm m)) ((e (in-list (fifth best))))
               (if (and (in-bounds? (+ i (first e)) (+ j (second e)) R C)
                        (zero? (at mm (+ i (first e)) (+ j (second e)))))
                   (set-cell mm (+ i (first e)) (+ j (second e))
                             (third e))
                   mm))
             m)))
     (cellmap g (r c v)
              (if (or (member r sep-rows) (member c sep-cols))
                  v
                  (let ((ri (index-in ris r)) (ci (index-in cis c)))
                    (if (and ri ci) (at filled ri ci) v)))))))
